title: Subtilly
summary: SUB'TILLY, adverb Thinly; not densely. 1. Finely; not grossly or thickly. The opakest bodies, if subtilly divided--become perfectly transparent. 2. Artfully; cunningly; craftily; as a scheme subtilly

inlines.v: SUB'TILLY, adverb Thinly; not densely. 1. Finely; not grossly or thickly. The opakest bodies, if subtilly divided--become perfectly transparent. 2. Artfully; cunningly; craftily; as a scheme subtilly contrived.
